From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@acme-corp.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor procurement kickoff — scheduling matrix & sequencing

Hi Julia / Samir —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to lock in a short vendor procurement kickoff that includes three stakeholders from both sides: AE (contract/pricing), SE (integration/permissions), and Procurement/Security from Acme.

Goal: align on procurement timeline, access requests (test data, IP allowlists), SOC2 evidence handoff, and next steps to get a Dedicated evaluation slot.

Can you confirm who from Acme will join for:
- Procurement operational lead (contracts/PO)
- Security/infosec reviewer (evidence questions)
- Eng/Platform contact (networking/VPC / integration)

Proposed 60-minute windows (PDT):
- Wed Jul 7: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jul 8: 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00

If those don't work, tell us a preferred day/time range and we can mirror availability. I attached a short procurement playbook that outlines the typical steps and artifacts we hand off.

Attachments: redwood_procurement_playbook_v1.pdf (1.1 MB)

Thanks — once we have attendees we'll send a one-pager agenda and the calendar invite.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Manager, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Naomi — thanks for sending. We're excited to move forward.

Quick notes from our side:
- I'll be the program sponsor and will attend.
- Samir (cc'd) is the procurement lead and prefers vendor kickoffs the week of Jul 12 due to quarterly POs closing this week.
- For security evidence, please include our security reviewer: Maya Chen (maya.chen@acme-corp.com). She prefers mornings ET.
- Our platform engineer (to discuss VPC/network) will be Julian Torres (julian.torres@acme-corp.com).

Suggested windows (ET):
- Tue Jul 13: 11:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed Jul 14: 10:00–11:00

Can you confirm Aditya and Diego's availability for those slots? Also please send an agenda and a mutual action plan (high level) that we can attach to our procurement tracker.

Thanks — forwarding Samir to coordinate PO requirements (cc'd).
